0x56c601a9: 您想要了解研究中心嗎？
0x56c601aa: At the Academy, we share your inquisitive nature. There's no need to look to the government to provide answers. The Academy has just the technology you need to build a city of tomorrow.
0x56c601ab: Workers fuel research for technologies to help your city run smoother and cleaner. Highly motivated wealthy workers complete research faster.
0x56c601ac: These technologies will attract high-tech industry and elevate your Sims as your city becomes a clean, green, high-tech metropolis.
0x56c601ad: All technology researched at the Academy requires a connection to ControlNet to function. Without a steady stream of ControlNet, the technology will not work.
0x56c601ae: Wealthier workers have the expertise necessary to provide a stronger ControlNet signal. Create medium and high wealth residential neighborhoods to help your Academy technology function.
0x623d4d5e: Welcome to SimCity: Cities of Tomorrow! This pack provides many ways to take your cities into the next century. Let's briefly tour all it has to offer.
0x623d4d5d: The advanced technology of Cities of Tomorrow can be found in City Specialization view.
0x623d4d5c: Your cities of tomorrow will tower higher than any others before. The new Superscrapers allow you to build your cities to the sky.
0x623d4d5b: Both Superscrapers and Elite Superscrapers provide everything Sims need within one utilitarian building. Stack layers of residences, shoppping and offices in a single imposing tower.
0x623d4d5a: OmegaCo is dedicated to advancing their profits, at any cost. This mega-corporation creates the all-purpose futuristic technology Omega.
0x623d4d59: Produce omega and distribute it throughout your city to earn franchise profits. Beware the Giant Robot's hunger for Omega as it spreads through your city.
0x623d4d58: Workers at the Academy dedicate their efforts to researching new technologies to improve your city, but must be supplied ControlNet via the Academy or staffed Academy Research Facilities.
0x623d4d57: All technologies researched by the Academy need to connect to Controlnet
0x623d4d56: Workers at the Academy or ControlNet Facilities broadcast ControlNet to your city.
0x42e58583: Welcome to the exciting world of drone manufacturing! OmegaCo drones are built using unique OmegaCo techniques.
0x42e58582: OmegaCo drones are created with processors. You'll need to manufacture those or buy them from the Global Market at a Trade Depot or Port.
0x42e58585: Drones will fly to houses to serve as helpful OmegaCo BuyDrones for your city's residents. This will let the residents stay at home and send their BuyDrone to shop for them.
0x42e58584: When BuyDrones return with goods from OmegaCo franchise shops, residents will be so grateful that their houses will become OmegaCo franchises, too! It's a franchise free for all!
0x42e58587: BuyDrones will eventually outlive their usefulness and need to be replaced. They will be tossed in the garbage and residents will have the opportunity to purchase the latest model!
0x42e58586: Drones are also used by Drone Levels in MegaTowers or Drone Safety Outposts. These convert drones into whatever type of drone is needed the most!
0x42e58589: Beware the space robot Outworlder 6's, hunger for drones, ControlNet and power! Just give it what it wants and it will go away.
0xd86622fc: 您想要認識《模擬城市：未來之城》嗎？
0xd86622ff: If your neighbor has the megacorporation OmegaCo, they may ship omega to your city's factories. This mysterious resource can your city's buildings into OmegaCo franchises, but don't be alarmed! You'll earn an extra wad of cash from these buildings, but they'll operate as normal!
0xd86622fe: OmegaCo cities may also send OmegaCo BuyDrones to shop in your city. These work just like shopping Sims, but fly over roads, so they won't cause traffic jams!
0xd86622f9: An OmegaCo HQ in the region will allow you to use new advanced mining and drilling modules that are much more efficient than any other modules, helping you make money faster!
0xd86622f8: Other cities in the region may have an Academy. This think tank researches advanced green technology, like wind and solar power amplifiers.
0xd86622fb: If an Academy researches these power amplifiers, you can add them to your power plants, but they will need to connect to ControlNet, which you can buy from a city with an Academy, but only if they're connected to you by road.
0xc7cc37a2: 您想要了解超級巨塔的哪些部分？
0xc7cc37a1: Build your city up, not out! Construct massive towers filled with huge populations and reduce traffic congestion with MegaTowers!
0xc7cc37a0: MegaTowers are self-contained communities, each level providing distinct functionality.
0xc7cc37a7: Residents pay you rent to live in Apartment Levels. People will move in or out depending on how happy they are. Keep Apartment Levels packed to make a profit from rent money!
0xc7cc37a6: You earn a share of the profits whenever shoppers buy goods from Mall Levels. Provide a steady stream of shoppers to Mall Levels to make a fortune in profits!
0xc7cc37a5: Though some workers can find jobs in Mall Levels, Office Levels provide a bulk of the jobs in MegaTowers. Make sure that Office Levels are full of workers to earn profits!
0xc7cc37a4: Taxes do not affect MegaTower levels. Changing the tax rate does not impact the happiness of residents living in MegaTowers, or change your income from MegaTowers.
0xc7cc37ab: MegaTower Levels do not change density on their own. If you want to change the type of a level, you can reconfigure it, for a nominal fee.
0xc7cc37aa: Service levels support basic levels in MegaTowers. Education, parks, power and even waste disposal allow you to create self-contained mini-cities in each tower!
0x287b9436: Build a MegaTower to eight levels and you can add a crown to the top! Each crown provides a powerful, expandable region-wide bonuses.
0x981ecda7: Welcome to the OmegaCo family! You have begun an epic journey of alignment with the OmegaCo brand identity! Soon you'll share the wonder of omega to buildings throughout the region!
0x981ecda6: Now that you have an OmegaCo Factory, you can make your own omega and ship it to industry in your city.
0x981ecda1: Omega is synthesized from Crude Oil and Raw Ore in an exclusive 'scientific' process. Import the Crude Oil and Raw Ore at an old-fashioned Trade Depot or Port, or extract them yourself.
0x981ecda0: Trucks from your OmegaCo Factory ship omega to industry in both your city and in neighboring cities.
0x981ecda3: But just what is omega? It's the last technology you'll ever need! Warning: omega may lead to ground pollution, increased fire risk and/or injury. Let's find out more! Click the OmegaCo menu button..
0x981ecda2: Brand loyalty has its privileges. Factories that receive omega shipments will eventually convert to OmegaCo franchises, providing you with hourly franchise profits.
0x981ecdad: Invest in an OmegaCo HQ to enhance your ability to create omega, increase brand awareness and even create OmegaCo drones so your city's homes can become franchises, too!
0x981ecdac: As OmegaCo spreads through your city, you'll want to share this exciting business opportunity with your friends! Ship omega to neighboring cities and they can become franchises, too!
